_doc: Per-test overrides + denominator ratchet for the node-suite harness. Default = a test is runnable. Add { "skip": true, "reason": "...", "category": "known_issues"|"flaky"|"" } ONLY for genuinely-unrunnable tests (native addon, internals flag, platform-N/A). 'ratchet': maxSkips/maxKnownIssues CAP the discretionary skip count (only ever LOWER them); minPass is a pass-count FLOOR (only ever RAISE it) so a node-compat regression that drops the pass count reddens CI. node-suite exits non-zero if skips exceed a ceiling OR passes fall below the floor. Auto-detected unrunnables (// Flags, missing node: builtin) are NOT counted against the skip ceiling. Raising minPass after landing fixes locks the gain in.
